ValidationRule.description: Rendre le champ “Dissemination Recipient” obligatoire quand Dissemination = Restricted
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.BypassValidationRules__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "X"), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "X2") ), ISPICKVAL(Dissemination__c, "Restricted"), ISBLANK(DisseminationRecipient__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select at least one Dissemination Recipient when Dissemination is set to Restricted.
